timeline.text: A Ukrainian-speaking parent logging her child's meal had to recognize a word written only in Norwegian.
Search for it in her own language and nothing came up — not even a close match.
Even new products scanned in by photo came back Norwegian-only, every time.
Now a Ukrainian line sits right under the Norwegian name, saved straight into Cloudflare.
Search овсянка today and it finds havregrøt — the same entry, in her own language.
